tasks.title: Restructure Project Folder Organization
tasks.description: Reorganize the backend folder structure to reflect the modular architecture described in the PRD, creating appropriate subdirectories for each functional module.
tasks.details:
Create the following directory structure in prototype/backend/:
- services/murmur_service/
- services/memory_system/
- services/tool_executor/
- services/dialogue_manager/
- services/ai_service/

Ensure each module directory has the appropriate __init__.py files and placeholder files for the main classes. Update import paths in existing files to maintain compatibility during the transition. This task should not change any functionality but prepare the codebase for modular refactoring.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the application still runs with the new directory structure. Run existing tests to ensure no functionality is broken by the reorganization. Check that import paths are correctly updated.

tasks.title: Extract Murmur Service Module
tasks.description: Refactor the self-talk (murmur) functionality into a separate MurmurService class with configurable context memory toggle.
tasks.details:
Create a MurmurService class in services/murmur_service/murmur_service.py that encapsulates all murmur-related functionality:
- Extract murmur generation logic from websocket.py
- Implement methods for murmur triggering (maybe_trigger_murmur)
- Add content generation (generate_murmur)
- Create configuration options for enabling/disabling murmur and context memory
- Move murmur-related constants (IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, MURMUR_MIN_INTERVAL_SECONDS) to config.py
- Ensure the service maintains state for recent murmurs when context memory is enabled

Update WebSocket handler to use the new MurmurService instead of embedded logic.
tasks.testStrategy:
Write unit tests for MurmurService that verify:
- Murmur triggering based on idle time
- Context memory toggle functionality
- Proper murmur generation with and without context
Manually test the application to ensure murmurs still occur at appropriate intervals and can be toggled via configuration.

tasks.title: Remove all tool detection and execution related code
tasks.description: Remove all tool detection and execution related code to simplify the backend and improve response time.
tasks.details:
Remove tool-related code and functionality:
1. Identify and remove tool detection and execution code from dialogue_graph.py
2. Modify the dialogue flow to no longer check for or execute tool functionality
3. Ensure the dialogue flow remains smooth and consistent after removal
4. Remove tool-related configuration settings
5. Remove unnecessary tool implementation code and files in the tools/ subdirectory
6. Ensure dependencies on tool functionality in other modules are properly addressed
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test the modified dialogue flow to ensure normal functionality is not affected
2. Measure and compare response times before and after tool functionality removal
3. Ensure no references to deleted functionality remain
4. Verify the system performs normally on all existing non-tool-related functionality

tasks.title: Refactor Memory Retrieval System
tasks.description: Optimize the memory retrieval system with parallel processing, result caching, and query limiting to achieve sub-500ms response times.
tasks.details:
Refactor the memory system in services/memory_system/:
- Create a MemoryRetriever class that orchestrates retrieval from different memory sources
- Implement parallel retrieval using asyncio.gather
- Add in-memory caching for recent query results
- Set limits on retrieval scope (k value) for each memory source
- Implement query skipping for simple greetings
- Add error isolation to prevent failures in one memory source from affecting others
- Separate query building, retrieval, and formatting into distinct components

Ensure the memory retrieval process is properly instrumented for performance measurement.
tasks.testStrategy:
Develop benchmark tests that measure memory retrieval performance:
- Test with various query types and memory store sizes
- Verify that response times are under 500ms for typical queries
- Test error scenarios to ensure graceful degradation
- Validate that caching improves performance for repeated queries
Implement unit tests for individual components (query builder, formatter, etc.).

subtasks.title: Create MemoryRetriever class structure and interfaces
subtasks.description: Design and implement the base MemoryRetriever class that will orchestrate memory retrieval from different sources
subtasks.details:
1. Create a new file `memory_retriever.py` in services/memory_system/
2. Define the MemoryRetriever class with initialization parameters for different memory sources
3. Create abstract methods for query building, retrieval, and formatting
4. Define interfaces for memory sources to implement
5. Add configuration parameters for retrieval limits and caching settings
6. Implement basic logging and instrumentation hooks
7. Test the class structure by creating a simple instance and verifying method signatures

subtasks.title: Implement parallel retrieval with asyncio
subtasks.description: Add parallel processing capability to retrieve from multiple memory sources simultaneously
subtasks.details:
1. Import asyncio and modify retrieval methods to be async
2. Create a main retrieve method that uses asyncio.gather to call multiple memory sources in parallel
3. Implement timeout handling for memory sources that take too long
4. Add error handling to catch and log exceptions from individual memory sources
5. Ensure results are properly aggregated after parallel retrieval
6. Test with mock memory sources to verify parallel execution
7. Measure and log execution time to verify performance improvements

subtasks.title: Implement in-memory caching system
subtasks.description: Add caching functionality to store and retrieve recent query results
subtasks.details:
1. Create a cache class with configurable size limits and expiration policies
2. Implement cache key generation based on query parameters
3. Add methods to store and retrieve results from cache
4. Integrate cache with the MemoryRetriever class
5. Implement cache statistics tracking (hits/misses)
6. Add cache invalidation mechanisms
7. Test caching with repeated queries to verify hit rates
8. Measure performance improvement from cached vs. non-cached queries

subtasks.title: Implement query optimization and skipping logic
subtasks.description: Add intelligence to skip unnecessary retrievals and optimize query parameters
subtasks.details:
1. Create a query analyzer component to detect simple greetings or queries that don't need memory retrieval
2. Implement configurable k-value limits for each memory source based on query type
3. Add query preprocessing to optimize search terms
4. Create a decision tree for determining which memory sources to query based on input
5. Implement early termination logic when sufficient results are found
6. Test with various query types to verify correct skipping behavior
7. Measure performance impact of skipping unnecessary retrievals

subtasks.title: Separate query building, retrieval, and formatting components
subtasks.description: Refactor the system to have distinct components for each stage of the memory retrieval process
subtasks.details:
1. Create separate QueryBuilder class with methods for different query types
2. Implement ResultFormatter class to standardize output from different memory sources
3. Refactor MemoryRetriever to use these components
4. Add extension points for custom query builders and formatters
5. Ensure proper error handling between components
6. Create unit tests for each component independently
7. Test the integration of all components together
8. Verify that the separation doesn't negatively impact performance

subtasks.title: Add comprehensive performance instrumentation
subtasks.description: Implement detailed performance tracking and reporting throughout the memory system
subtasks.details:
1. Add timing decorators for all key methods
2. Implement detailed logging with performance metrics
3. Create a performance dashboard or reporting mechanism
4. Add counters for cache hits/misses, query skips, and error rates
5. Implement configurable performance thresholds with alerts
6. Add tracing to identify bottlenecks in the retrieval process
7. Create load testing scripts to verify sub-500ms response times
8. Document performance optimization techniques and results

tasks.title: Refactor WebSocket Dialogue Handler
tasks.description: Restructure the WebSocket connection handler to separate state management and event processing from the main handler function.
tasks.details:
Create a ConversationSession class to manage dialogue state:
- Move state variables (speaking_state, current_emotion, etc.) from function scope to class attributes
- Implement methods for handling different message types and events
- Separate the main WebSocket handler logic from state management
- Use the refactored MurmurService, ToolExecutor, and MemoryRetriever
- Ensure clean separation of concerns between connection handling and dialogue processing

Update the WebSocket endpoint to create and use ConversationSession instances for each connection.
tasks.testStrategy:
Create unit tests for ConversationSession that verify:
- Proper state transitions during conversation
- Correct handling of different message types
- Integration with MurmurService, ToolExecutor, and MemoryRetriever
Manually test WebSocket connections to ensure the refactored handler maintains all existing functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Dialogue Graph Abstraction
tasks.description: Refactor the dialogue flow graph to separate node definitions from graph construction and execution.
tasks.details:
Restructure dialogue_graph.py into a more modular system:
- Create a base Node class in dialogue_manager/graph_nodes/
- Implement specific node types (ToolIntentDetectionNode, MemoryFetchNode, etc.)
- Separate graph definition (nodes and edges) from execution logic
- Make tool-related paths configurable and separable from normal dialogue
- Implement a clean interface for adding/removing nodes and paths
- Use the ToolExecutor and MemoryRetriever services through well-defined interfaces

Ensure the dialogue graph can be easily modified without changing core execution logic.
tasks.testStrategy:
Develop unit tests for individual node types and the graph execution engine:
- Test node behavior in isolation
- Verify correct path selection based on input conditions
- Test graph execution with various configurations
- Ensure tool paths can be enabled/disabled without affecting normal dialogue
Test the complete dialogue flow to validate that refactored graph maintains existing behavior.

tasks.title: Integrate Redis for Caching
tasks.description: Set up Redis as a caching layer for memory retrieval results and session state.
tasks.details:
Implement Redis integration for caching:
- Add Redis client configuration in core/config.py
- Modify MemoryRetriever to use Redis for caching query results
- Implement cache key generation, TTL settings, and invalidation logic
- Update ConversationSession to optionally persist state in Redis
- Add environment variables for Redis connection settings
- Create fallback mechanisms for when Redis is unavailable

Ensure proper serialization/deserialization of cached data and appropriate TTL settings based on data type.
tasks.testStrategy:
Create integration tests with Redis:
- Verify cache hits and misses behave correctly
- Test performance improvement with caching enabled vs. disabled
- Validate proper TTL and invalidation of cached items
- Test system behavior when Redis is unavailable
Measure memory retrieval performance with Redis caching to ensure it meets the 500ms target.

tasks.title: Implement Celery for Background Tasks
tasks.description: Set up Celery task queue for handling background processing tasks like memory maintenance.
tasks.details:
Integrate Celery for background task processing:
- Set up Celery configuration with Redis as broker
- Identify and implement background tasks (memory cleanup, etc.)
- Create task definitions in appropriate service modules
- Implement task scheduling and execution logic
- Add environment variables for Celery configuration
- Document how to run Celery workers

Ensure tasks are properly isolated and don't interfere with the main application flow.
tasks.testStrategy:
Create tests for Celery tasks:
- Verify tasks execute correctly in isolation
- Test task scheduling and completion
- Validate that background tasks don't affect main application performance
- Test error handling in background tasks
Document testing procedures for Celery integration.

tasks.title: Implement Monitoring and Error Handling
tasks.description: Set up OpenTelemetry for performance monitoring and improve error handling throughout the application.
tasks.details:
Implement comprehensive monitoring and error handling:
- Integrate OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing
- Add trace points at key operations (memory retrieval, tool execution, etc.)
- Implement structured logging throughout the application
- Create error boundaries around critical components
- Add graceful degradation for non-critical failures
- Set up health check endpoints for monitoring
- Document monitoring setup and dashboard configuration

Ensure all external API calls have proper timeout and retry logic.
tasks.testStrategy:
Verify monitoring and error handling:
- Test that traces are properly collected for key operations
- Simulate various error conditions and verify proper handling
- Validate that health checks accurately reflect system state
- Test graceful degradation scenarios
Create documentation for interpreting monitoring data and troubleshooting common issues.

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Tests and Documentation
tasks.description: Develop comprehensive test suite and documentation for the refactored backend.
tasks.details:
Complete testing and documentation:
- Create end-to-end tests for critical user flows
- Implement integration tests for service interactions
- Ensure unit test coverage for all new modules
- Write developer documentation for each module
- Create setup and configuration guides
- Document performance characteristics and optimization strategies
- Prepare templates for adding new tools, memory types, etc.

Organize documentation in a structured manner for easy reference.
tasks.testStrategy:
Review test coverage and documentation quality:
- Verify that all critical paths have test coverage
- Conduct peer review of documentation
- Test that new developers can understand and extend the system using only the documentation
- Validate that documentation accurately reflects the implemented system
